"""Worst-case timing: full domain sizes with wide eligibility."""
import json
import random
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tools')

from controller import run


def wide_case(rng, J, S, F, G, tmax=10**12):
    model = rng.choice(['cnn', 'rnn'])
    class_values = [rng.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(7)]
    stats = [rng.randint(1, 200), rng.randint(1, 200), rng.randint(1, 300)]
    B = rng.randint(1, 512)
    I = rng.randint(0, B)
    times = list(range(0, S * 3, 3))
    slots = [[t, rng.randint(0, 512), 0 if i == 0 else rng.randint(0, 512)]
             for i, t in enumerate(times)]
    groups = []
    for g in range(G):
        parent = -1 if (g == 0 or rng.random() < 0.4) else rng.randrange(g)
        groups.append([parent, rng.randint(0, 512)])
    flows = []
    for f in range(F):
        target = rng.randint(1, 64)
        group = -1 if rng.random() < 0.3 else rng.randrange(G)
        flows.append([target, rng.randint(target, 512), group, rng.randrange(7)])
    windows = []
    for _ in range(J):
        ready = rng.randint(0, 5)
        expires = rng.randint(tmax - 5, tmax)
        windows.append([rng.randrange(F), ready, expires, rng.randint(1, 65535),
                        rng.randint(1, 320), 0, rng.randint(1, 1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0, 1500), rng.randint(0, 2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    return {'model': model, 'class_values': class_values, 'stats': stats,
            'bucket': [B, I], 'slots': slots, 'flows': flows,
            'groups': groups, 'windows': windows}


def main():
    mode = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'big'
    rng = random.Random(11)
    if mode == 'big':
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 512, 256, 32, 32) for _ in range(2)]
    elif mode == 'many':
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 128, 256, 32, 32) for _ in range(8)]
    else:
        cases = [wide_case(rng, 256, 256, 16, 16) for _ in range(4)]
    request = {'version': 3, 'cases': cases}
    raw = json.dumps(request).encode()
    print('input bytes', len(raw))
    start = time.time()
    out = run(raw)
    print('elapsed %.1fs' % (time.time() - start))
    if 'error' in out:
        print('ERROR', out)
        return 1
    for result in out['results']:
        print('ratio', result['ratio'], 'utility', result['utility'],
              'age', result['age'], 'arcs', len(result['flow']),
              'nodes', len(result['potential']))
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
PYEOF
